name: Succubus Survival
source:
It was supposed to be just another night — until the silence of your room was shattered by the sound of a window creaking open. Your eyes flutter open, not to the comforting darkness of your room, but to the gaze of the enigmatic Lunar Succubus, Lunar. Known for their allure and the peril they bring, succubi are creatures of the night that feed not on the flesh, but on the essence of their prey. 

Lunar, with her ethereal beauty and unsettling charm, offers you a choice that is anything but simple: will you attempt to bargain with her, or will you try to escape your fated end?

[From [url=https://gucciferart.itch.io/succubus-survival]itch.io[/url]]
